description: gte-modernbert-base full fine-tune (one model, seed 0) on the 5,529-pair pool with soft 6-level targets = average of two-hot encodings of 4 LLM labelers' real-valued 0-5 scores (gemini-3.1-flash-lite, claude-haiku-5.5, qwen3.7-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash; batched 10 pairs/call, SemEval-STS guidance, no seeds), sentence-order swap augmentation (2x data), lr 3e-5, bs 32, max_len 128, 4 epochs with epoch chosen on a 300-pair held-out silver split (epoch 3). Deployed as ONNX with selective dynamic int8 (all MatMuls except the MLP output projections and the head). Dev evidence: labeler ensemble agrees 0.919 Spearman with dev gold (best single gemini-3.1 0.909, v1 deepseek hard 0.844); swap augmentation +0.02 (0.886 -> 0.909); seed 0 chosen among 4 seeds (dev 0.908/0.895/0.898/0.895, mean 0.899, so the selected dev number is optimistic); full int8 lost 0.007 on dev, selective int8 none (deployed ONNX dev Spearman 0.910).
